about_short_description.short_description: Kino AI builds software tools that automatically infer metadata and organize footage, making video post-production faster.

product.name: Kino AI Assistant
product.description: An AI assistant for tracking footage metadata and organizing media assets, compatible with various editing workflows.

product.name: Backup, Sync, Organize
product.description: Automatically backs up files from SD cards to pre-designated locations, compatible with external hard drives and cloud storage, and reorganizes files into a custom folder structure.

product.name: AI Transcription
product.description: Generates timecode-synced transcripts of videos, names files by the slate, marks interesting moments, and matches scenes to a script.

product.name: Metadata Labeling
product.description: Automatically populates metadata into a digital codebook compatible with any editing environment and shareable across departments.

product.name: Automatic Audio-Visual Sync
product.description: Synchronizes audio and video files automatically.

product.name: Sound Artifact Removal
product.description: Removes unwanted sound artifacts from audio files.
